quote: Just reaching back out about that design for your home.
stewart_read: Rep confirms a prior design exists but never probes what it showed, who built it, or why the last meeting didn't happen — pure logistics, no context recovery.
alternative_hypothesis: This could be a legitimate short reschedule call where the prior design details are already on file elsewhere in Ion's system, making re-probing redundant.
coaching_implication: Even on a reschedule, a quick 'did you get a chance to look at the numbers we put together?' keeps curiosity alive going into the closer meeting.

coaching_implication: Add the 'we'll block an hour, please be at a computer, does that work for you?' sequence even on quick reschedule calls — it protects show rate.
